title: github-copilot-cli hook stdout contract
description: Seam 4 of the adapter's invocation plumbing: the single JSON object the adapter prints on stdout (exit 0) for the Copilot CLI runtime to honor. Empty stdout is a valid pass-through and is NOT governed by this contract. The adapter never emits `permissionDecision: allow` (an authorized call passes through to the runtime's normal permission flow) and never `ask` (denied in autopilot and cloud agent), and never `modifiedArgs`: it never edits an agent's command. Grounded in https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/hooks-reference (preToolUse decision control, postToolUse output, userPromptTransformed, sessionStart/subagentStart additionalContext).

denyDecision.description: preToolUse — H2/H3 deny, H4 (the hook-executed harness request: its report as a RESULT reason, or a REJECTED reason), and every fail-closed path. Covers the whole batch.

transformedPromptDecision.description: userPromptTransformed — H0: the orchestrator's workflow context prepended to the model-facing prompt (userPromptSubmitted output is ignored by the runtime).

postToolUseDecision.description: postToolUse — H5 write rejected: the tool result replaced (resultType must be success) plus the retry directive.

contextDecision.description: sessionStart (harness command line), subagentStart (H1 step context), postToolUse (H5/H6 directives, late H0 context). The runtime caps a postToolUse additionalContext at 10 KB (the adapter cuts it there); sessionStart/subagentStart context is bounded only by the 10 MiB hook-output limit.

context.description: A postToolUse additionalContext: capped by the runtime at 10 KB.

sessionContext.description: A sessionStart/subagentStart additionalContext: bounded by the 10 MiB hook-output limit.
